summary: The requirement document describes a booking website and a front-desk system for a group of three resorts with 140 rooms. Guests see the rooms, book and pay online and get confirmations, while staff handle check-in, billing with GST, housekeeping, stock and guest records, and managers see revenue reports. Room rates stay in step with travel websites through a channel manager, and the vendor hosts and supports the system for two years.
